name: duely
about: B2B SaaS, plain voice, price on a pricing page

pages.title: Duely – Invoice reminders that get you paid
pages.description: Duely sends polite payment reminders for your invoices so you stop chasing clients.
headings: Get paid without the awkward emails
Works with the invoices you already send
Built for freelancers and small studios
pages.text: Get paid without the awkward emails. Duely watches the invoices you send and follows up for you. A friendly reminder goes out on day 3, a firmer one on day 7 and a final one on day 14. Clients pay from a link in the email. Duely works with invoices from QuickBooks, Xero and plain PDF. Built for freelancers and small studios who invoice 3 to 20 clients a month. You see every reminder before it is sent the first time, then Duely keeps the schedule.

pages.title: Pricing – Duely
pages.description: One plan. $12 a month. Cancel any time.
pages.text: One simple plan. $12 per month for unlimited invoices and reminders. 14-day free trial, no card needed. Cancel any time from your settings.
